verdict.rationale: Motion runs a lot of built-in autonomous background behavior: it reshuffles schedules automatically, advances projects when blocking tasks complete, blocks time for recurring tasks, enforces meeting limits and schedules forwarded emails as tasks. The only user-configurable automation is an 'AI Workflow Builder' that builds workflows from SOPs, and it rests on a single one-line marketing mention, so most of this autonomy is fixed system behavior rather than automations a user sets up. missing for 10: documented user-defined triggers/actions or rule builder, detail on how the AI Workflow Builder executes workflows unattended, hands-on or independent corroboration.
